user.description:
Enter your EZVIZ account credentials, the device serial number and the device type (HP5 intercom or PTZ camera such as the CB8 Lite).

To find the serial number: open the EZVIZ app, select your device, tap the settings gear icon, then "Device Info" — the serial number is listed there. It is also printed on the physical label/QR code on the device.
